presets.description: One fixed reflectance window for all three bands, so colors compare across plates and seasons. A good default for vegetated and mixed scenes.
presets.label: Natural

presets.description: Each band stretched to its own 2–98 % range in the frame. Neutralises casts and fills the tonal range; colors are relative to this scene.
presets.label: Balanced

presets.description: Per-band black points at the 1st percentile remove the blue-heavy atmospheric veil (dark-object subtraction) while one shared gain keeps the color balance; a gentle S-curve and a little chroma restore depth.
presets.label: Haze-cut

presets.description: A wide fixed window that keeps snow, ice, salt flats and dunes from clipping to white; a soft S-curve keeps the darks from going flat.
presets.label: Bright surfaces
